licenceRule: Licence is set per repository (Alex, 2026-11-21). Product repositories are AGPL-3.0-only and take no outside code for now. Work meant to be copied stays permissive: the profile-recipes recipes are CC0-1.0 and the lexicon schemas are MIT, and those two take outside work with a DCO sign-off only. Third-party work keeps its own licence. There is no contributor agreement.
